newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian base metals steady on lower arrivals.
newsitem.headline: Indian base metals steady on lower arrivals.

text.p: Indian base metals were at previous levels on Monday after last week's impressive rally, dealers said.
"Fresh industrial buying slowed down but limited arrivals of imports kept prices at previous level," one dealer said.
Volumes were low ahead of the Januarey 14 kite festival. Traders were awaiting the new selling prices by state firms for the second half of the current month.
Ready copper was steady at 12,550 rupees per quintal. Nickel was unchanged at 36,800 and tin at 34,500 rupees. Aluminium was steady at 7,200 rupees, zinc at 6,500 rupees and lead at 4,400.
